title: T-055 matched cube and truncated-octahedron parent-input boundary
question: Can the current T-055 transfer be advanced to a matched finite cube-versus-truncated-octahedron parent calculation with a common empty/reference branch, full-tangent stationarity, transverse Hessian, finite gap, propagation cone, and anisotropy certificate?
method: Re-run the registered R-169 truncated-octahedron realization and empty-reference fixtures in the primary, independent, and integrated lanes.
Inspect the current T-055 candidate contract for a frozen parent functional, state/configuration space, boundary, counterterm finite parts, and limit order.

Inspect the canonical A1 production-functional authority and the repository code inventory for a geometry-matched finite implementation of energy, full-tangent Hessian, finite gap, propagation cone, and anisotropy.
Apply the same-input rule: do not construct a new parent functional, center rule, reference branch, or finite-part convention merely to make the truncated-octahedron comparison executable.
finding: The R-169 geometry and empty-reference route is reproducible, but the requested matched parent calculation cannot yet be run from the current authoritative inputs. The canonical A1 production-functional manifest is explicitly marked external-source-audit-fail with only a standalone discrete variational-matrix backend passing; it also records a declared-functional versus implemented-residual mismatch. No current repository implementation applies one hash-pinned, owner-approved parent functional to both cubic and truncated-octahedral geometries while certifying full-tangent stationarity, transverse Hessian, finite gap, propagation cone, and anisotropy. Proceeding would introduce an unauthorized model choice and would not be evidence for C6 or Pre-A.
decision_reason: The geometry lane is ready for reuse, but the proof-bearing comparison is input-blocked rather than numerically failed. The correct next action is to obtain or explicitly freeze an owner-approved geometry-independent parent functional and all comparison conventions, then implement primary and independent matched calculations before any sign or stability promotion.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing input and route boundary only. No truncated-octahedron or cubic vacuum, BCC selection, physical-empty sign, stationarity, transverse stability, finite gap, propagation cone, anisotropy, continuum/thermodynamic limit, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, QFT, or Yang--Mills result follows.
next_action: Keep the R-169 fixtures as regression controls. Before implementing the matched calculation, freeze the current-owner parent functional hash, admissible state/configuration space, center and boundary rules, empty/reference branch, counterterm basis and finite parts, units, matched volume/degree-of-freedom/cutoff contract, error budget, and limit order. If those inputs are not supplied, retain the T-055 route at this boundary and do not infer a candidate sign.
no_overclaim: A reproducible geometry fixture is not a parent-functional comparison. The standalone A1 backend pass does not repair the external-source mismatch or authorize a new truncated-octahedron model.

qft_interface.closed: Only the finite geometry/reference fixtures and their independent reproduction contract are available.
qft_interface.open: An owner-approved parent functional, matched candidate/reference states, full-tangent stationarity, transverse stability, finite-size uniformity, continuum/thermodynamic limits, QFT reconstruction, C6, Sector A, and Pre-A.
qft_interface.route: Owner-approved parent functional -> matched cubic/TO finite calculation -> uniform sign/stability and limit tests -> only then C6/Pre-A interpretation.

adversarial_review.check: The primary, independent, and integrated geometry fixtures all pass, but this does not supply an energy or state model.
The A1 manifest's standalone backend pass is not treated as an external-source repair; its declared-functional and residual mismatch remains binding.
No new parent functional, reference branch, counterterm finite part, center rule, or boundary is introduced to force a comparison.
Even a future finite sign, gap, or anisotropy pass would require uniform error and limit control before C6 or Pre-A interpretation.
The T-055 geometry lane remains separate from the Q3 common-history/QFT route and cannot close OS/KMS/GNS, Sector A, or Pre-A.
